messages:
liz: Quick heads-up — joint webinar with NimbusCloud + AtlasHW next Wed 11:00am PT. Need a short run-through (10:15 rehearsal), final speaker list, slide deck, demo kit manifest, and swag clearance by EOD Fri. Agenda + folders: https://drive.example.com/partner-summit -> please confirm ownerships.
omar: Added to my calendar :calendar: who's on shipping for the hardware kits?
rafa: I can run the live demo. Quick question: which model variant should we serve for the live demo — low-latency quantized or high-quality float?
kevin: Recommend model-v2.1-quant as primary, fallback to hosted-micro for stability. If GPU flake, I'll flip routing to hosted.
sophie: I'll take slides + co-branding. Need vector logos from partners (SVG preferably). @liz can you confirm we have the assets?
liz: Partners uploaded logos to the drive folder. I'll DM links. Also partners asked for a 2-slide co-brand intro and one CTA slide.
mara-bot: Reminder: Partner rehearsal scheduled Wed 10:15am PT in Zoom room "Partner Rehearsal" — calendar invites sent.
omar: Shipping notes — how many kits to send? floorplan shows 4 demo stations + 2 backstops.
liz: Ship 6 kits (4 demo, 2 spares). Weight ~12kg/kit. For EU customs we need HS code 8471 and a pro forma invoice.
rafa: Manifest uploaded here: https://drive.example.com/manifest-2026 (contains serials + power draw).
kevin: Run order suggestion (rough):
```
1) 11:00 Intro (liz)
2) 11:05 Partner keynote (Nimbus)
3) 11:12 Live demo (rafa)
4) 11:28 Q&A + CTA (sophie)
```
sophie: Swag question — partner prefers low-touch items for EU booths. Can we do stickers + postcard instead of USB hubs?
liz: They agreed to stickers only for EU due to customs. We'll do sticker bundles stateside.
rafa: I'll test Atlas card with quantized model Monday morning — saw a kernel mismatch last run, want to repro early.
omar: AV checklist: laptop, HDMI -> DisplayPort, spare power strip, ethernet cable. Someone want to own booth handoff at 10:30am?
sophie: I'll own booth handoff + slide upload. Please upload final deck to the folder by Mon EOD so I can compile for comms.
kevin: Fallback plan: if hardware demo fails, I'll switch the stream to hosted endpoint and mirror the sequence. I'll also have a short prerecorded clip of the demo as backup.
liz: Who's the live moderator for Q&A? we should confirm a single voice to field partner questions.
sophie: I can moderate Q&A. Can one of the partners be on the line for 10:15 rehearsal?
rafa: I'll coordinate with Nimbus to join rehearsal and test screen share.
omar: Customs paperwork — can someone add HS code and invoice template to the shipping doc? I'll need it for the courier.
liz: Done, added template to the folder.
kevin: Also recommend we provision a temporary guest routing key for the demo environment (read-only). I'll create a placeholder and share in the secure doc.
sophie: Small ask — can marketing get two co-branded headshots for the panel? partners can supply theirs by Thu.
liz: Noted. I'll ping partner ops for headshots.
rafa: Final tech preflight: I'll post a short checklist after Monday tests (latency numbers, cold-start time, kv cache priming).
kevin: I'll bring a spare NUC for streaming + an HDMI capture if we need local fallback.
omic: :thumbsup: (meant to be a quick reaction)
liz: Perfect — thanks everyone. Upload things to the drive folder and add any blockers here. See you at rehearsal Wed 10:15am PT. :rocket:
